definitions: A type of interpretable machine learning model that explicitly represents and reasons with human-understandable concepts.
A model architecture designed to improve transparency and interpretability in AI systems by forcing the model to make predictions based on an intermediate layer of concepts.
An AI model that first predicts a set of human-interpretable concepts from the input, and then uses these concepts to make a final prediction.
examples: The concept bottleneck model provided clear insights into its decision-making process.
Researchers developed a new concept bottleneck model for medical diagnosis.
Understanding the internal workings of the concept bottleneck model was crucial for debugging.
